Your Lord forgave your brother at the time of his ascension, purified him of sins, and admitted him to a station that the tongues of those who know are powerless to describe. From this station We send greetings to My loved ones there who have drunk the choice wine of My utterance and attained what has flowed from My Most Exalted Pen. Your Lord is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. May glory from God, the Lord of Names, rest upon you and upon those whose names have been sent down in My preserving Tablet. End.

**126** Praise be to God, the sun of generosity is shining, the ocean of loving care is manifest, and the Euphrates of utterance flows and spreads without interruption. This mortal asks and hopes that God will deprive no one on earth of the fragrant breezes of this most exalted and most holy Day, and will enable everyone to do what He loves and approves. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.

**127** Convey greetings from this mortal to all the friends, and say: “These days are unlike other days, and this time is unlike the times before and after it. Strive to gain a share of the light of the divine dawn.” He indeed has power over whatever He wills. There is no God but Him, the Almighty, the Most Great.

**128** May glory rest upon you, upon those with you, and upon those who have turned with radiant hearts toward God, our Lord and your Lord, our heart’s desire and your heart’s desire, and the heart’s desire of all who are in the heavens and on earth.

**129** After the letter was completed and I entered the Most Holy Presence, the tongue of the Beloved spoke these exalted and blessed words: “O Warqāʾ, upon you be My glory, My mercy, and My loving care. Wisdom and its meanings have been explained to some extent. Today, however, wisdom consists of conduct, deeds, and words that guide people to the Most Exalted Horizon without raising an uproar or giving rise to turmoil and discord. The people are indeed sunk in a strange sleep and manifest doubt. They worship conjectures and do not understand; they hasten toward delusions and do not perceive. Through forbearance and compassion, the heedless must be awakened and guided to the ocean of loving care. Some of the ignorant, who fly on the wings of self and desire and burn with the fire of hatred, lie in wait at their watchposts, seeking a pretext to raise objections against God, exalted be His glory, and His loved ones.” End.

**130** God willing, may all the friends of God be adorned with wisdom, and may each manifest what indicates and attests to the exaltation of the Cause. May God grant the learned men of this age fairness and bestow sight upon them, so that they may behold the rays of the Sun of Truth, shining brightly at its zenith, and not remain deprived of it. These souls have always been, and remain, a cause of error and misguidance, except those whom God wills. This servant asks his Lord to grant them understanding, teach them what they have overlooked, and draw them near to Him as a grace from Himself. He is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful.

**131** Another matter: you \[wrote\] concerning your exalted, departed father, who attained the divine presence at the time of his ascension. During the days when Abū’l-Ḥasan, upon him be 9 66 \[the glory of God\], was in the Holy Land, one day he and this servant were both in the Most Holy Presence, before His face. Suddenly the tongue of the Desire of all the worlds spoke, and a most exalted and most holy Tablet was revealed in your father’s remembrance and given to the aforementioned gentleman to deliver. May you, dear friend, be assured concerning your exalted father—upon him be the most glorious of all glory.

**132** On numerous occasions, words in his remembrance have been revealed in such a manner that the hearts of those who know soar through them. In particular, on several occasions the Beloved of all the worlds was heard speaking of his services and his steadfastness in the Cause of God. He has remembered him in words that will never perish, and will remember him in words toward which hearts and souls will turn.

**133** At the close of this letter, this mortal offers just this: you have attained the loving care of the Beloved, and this is glad tidings from me to you.
